title: Rose Tico
description: Resistance maintenance tech Rose Tico nearly gave her life at the Battle of trait. Rose recovered and was stationed at the Resistance base on Ajan Kloss. She worked closely with General Leia Organa and provided crucial analysis of the ships of the First Order. During the Battle of Exegol, she served with Finn's team for the attack on the Nav Tower. She celebrated with the others after their victory.
